import unittest

class Contract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        import jsonlines as m
        self.assertEqual(m.read(iter(['', '{"x": 1}', '   '])), [{'x': 1}])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'line 3') as caught: m.read(['', '{}', '{bad'])
        self.assertIsNotNone(caught.exception.__cause__)
